# Health OS design system

> The design and brand reference for Health OS, built for AI agents first and people second. Light and paper themes; Spline Sans headings and Anonymous Pro body; rose, apricot and lavender in three shades each; three gradients; 33 components, six card types, 31 widgets and a tagged image library.

Read in this order. Take every value from the tokens and never type a hex, size, radius, shadow or duration by hand. Claims, prices, offers and voice come from the Health OS database (teamos-ai/db-health-os), which this system never overrides. Tumai approves every exception.

## Start here

- [CLAUDE.md](design-system/CLAUDE.md): the rules, the load order and how to change the system.
- [CHECKLIST.md](design-system/CHECKLIST.md): the 14 checks to run before shipping any page, post, email or asset.
- [REFERENCE.md](design-system/REFERENCE.md): every token table and all 107 entries with purpose, when to use, when not to, API and source, plus the 11 open decisions.

## Values

- [tokens.json](design-system/tokens/tokens.json): the only source of token values, with a description on every token.
- [tokens.css](design-system/tokens/tokens.css): generated CSS variables for any consumer, both themes.
- [tailwind.preset.js](design-system/tokens/tailwind.preset.js): generated Tailwind preset. Off-system classes produce no CSS.

## Brand, voice and recipes

- [BRAND-SUMMARY.md](design-system/BRAND-SUMMARY.md): what Health OS is and how it should feel, in one page.
- [VOICE.md](design-system/VOICE.md): how copy sits inside the system, and where the database takes over.
- [ASSET-RECIPES.md](design-system/ASSET-RECIPES.md): which tokens and components to use for each kind of page or asset.
- [logo/usage.md](design-system/logo/usage.md): the mark, its grounds and sizes.

## Data

- [catalog.json](design-system/reference/catalog.json): the catalogue behind the site and REFERENCE.md.
- [photos.ts](src/data/photos.ts), [backgrounds.ts](src/data/backgrounds.ts), [media.ts](src/data/media.ts): the image library with context tags, tone, text space and one suggested use per image.
- [offer.ts](src/data/offer.ts): plan names and AUD prices used in examples, copied from the database.

## Optional

- [README.md](README.md): the repository, commands and the build checks.
- Reference site: https://ds-healthos.vercel.app
